messages:
anya: Quick check-in on postmortem follow-ups for the GPU capacity incident. We need single-line owner | ETA | blockers for each action so I can create the Jira board. Items: quota request (EU), scheduler tuning, headroom runbook, autoscaler scale-down tweak, recurring-patterns doc. Reply with your line.

maria: Owner: maria | ETA: 2026-03-31 | Blockers: waiting on finance approval for reserved commit; I filed the cloud quota ticket and pinged sales.

kenji: Owner: kenji | ETA: 2026-04-08 | Blockers: need staging perf runs to validate backoff change; branch is feature/sched-backoff. Will attach latency graphs.

nick: Owner: nick | ETA: 2026-04-16 | Blockers: need finalized 95th/99th pct seq-length distribution from evals team; drafting headroom runbook + calc for 15-25% buffer.

sean: Owner: sean | ETA: 2026-04-03 | Blockers: want to canary scale-down window in non-prod first. Proposal: scaleDown stabilizationWindowSeconds 600 -> 900 for HPA/gpu-controller. I will open RFC.

jasmin: Owner: jasmin | ETA: 2026-04-10 | Blockers: none; will document recurring triggers (quota, batch bursts, scheduler preemption) and map alerts -> pager.

irina: I can help on the quota justification doc and cost delta. Ping me maria if finance needs numbers.

incident-bot: Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-gpu-capacity.md (postmortem + action list).

anya: Notes: maria, escalate to me if finance blocks past 3/31. kenji, include before/after tail-latency in PR. nick, add an ops checklist for runbook. sean, schedule non-prod canary for 3/29. jasmin, add alert-to-pager mapping.

kenji: question: should we fold small quantization experiments into headroom or track separately?

nick: keep as a subtask in headroom owned by research; non-blocking.

maria: filing cost delta now.

anya: I'll create the Jira board and assign tickets to the names above. Reconvene at follow-up sync next Wed 11am PT. If any ETA slips >72h update the ticket and mention me. React with :white_check_mark: if your line is final.

kenji: :white_check_mark:

maria: :white_check_mark:

nick: :white_check_mark:

sean: :white_check_mark:

jasmin: :white_check_mark:

irina: :white_check_mark:

anya: Thanks — closing thread.
